summary.text: Donna Scheuren is a Republican member of the Pennsylvania House of Representatives from District 147, having taken office on December 1, 2022, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Her career experience includes working as a manufacturer's representative.

paragraphs.text: Scheuren graduated from Cherokee High School in New Jersey in 1987 and earned a B.S. in business administration from the College of New Jersey in 1991.
Her career experience includes working as the representative of a manufacturer.
In the 2023-2024 session, Scheuren was assigned to the Commerce Committee, where she was subcommittee chair on Automation and Technology, and to the Professional Licensure Committee.
